public_definitions: Routing criterion: 'Larger 2014 age-group population share shown in the dashboard'.
Task: compare the 2014 population share for 0-14 years and 65 years +, then open the age-group public services planning follow-up record for the group with the larger 2014 share.
uncertain: Exact 2014 percentage values for both series are not printed as point labels; left/right axis tick numerals are not legible, so the 2014 comparison relies on relative marker height and the trend implied by nearby annotations (blue ~14.82% in 2012-13 declining to 14.2% by 2016; red ~20.1% in 2013 rising to 21.4% by 2017).

Because the two series use separate left/right axes, a direct visual height comparison at 2014 is not a guaranteed equal-scale comparison; the printed annotations suggest the red 65+ series values (~20%+) exceed the blue 0-14 series values (~14%) around 2014, but the exact 2014 figures are not explicitly labeled.
